messages:
alex_m: heads-up — ops wants to backfill sampled telemetry for Q4 so the retention dashboards and alerting evals are complete. main blocker: historical request/response logs may contain PII. need a safe plan before we reingest.

nina_g: agree. i think we should treat this like a migration: dry-run -> validate redaction -> reingest. can we avoid pulling full payloads into the central lake until scrubbed?

samir_r: +1. propose pipeline: 1) export sampled events to staging bucket, 2) run redaction job (fast-hash pseudonymize + regex scrub + pii-heuristics), 3) reingest into telemetry store. keep originals encrypted and inaccessible except for breakglass.

priya_k: product question: dashboards depend on route and model-version metadata which live in the payload today. if we redact too aggressively we lose signal. can we keep non-PII metadata (route, model_id, latency, tokens) and only redact request/resp text?

ben_ops: that's workable. plan: preserve structured metadata fields, redact free-text. also maintain an audit trail of what was redacted (hashes + rule ids) — stored separately with stricter ACLs.

alex_m: how confident are we in our existing PII heuristics? we've had false negatives in syslogs before.

nina_g: not 100%. i'd run a classifier + regex ensemble. sample size: run classifier on 2% subset first, manually spot-check 500 items. if false negative > 0.5% escalate to security.

samir_r: here's a rough redaction config we can run in k8s job (pseudo):

```
redaction_rules:
  - id: phone_email
    type: regex
    pattern: '(\\+?\\d[\\d \-]{7,}|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,})'
    action: replace_with_hash
  - id: credit_card
    type: luhn
    action: redact_full
  - id: model_prompt
    type: nlp-classifier
    threshold: 0.85
    action: redact_partial
```

samir_r: we also need to keep sampling provenance attached so billing/quota math still works (sample_rate, sampler_version, original_shard_ts).

priya_k: console UX/ops: we should surface how much of each dashboard is from backfilled vs live data. otherwise on-call will be confused when baselines shift.

ben_ops: add a boolean flag on rows "backfilled=true/false" and create per-metric annotations in the console (tooltip: "backfilled data added on <date>"). low-effort.

alex_m: security/compliance: tagging @security @compliance — is there any policy preventing reingestion of older logs even if redacted?

telemetrybot: @security FYI — scheduled redaction backfill job queued (dry-run) for project: telemetry-backfill-q4. Job id: tbq4-2026-dry-01

security: (via @security) we need an SLA for manual review for any records flagged as high-risk by classifier. recommend breakglass audit + unredacted access only with 2-person approval.

nina_g: agree. operationally, dry-run should produce a delta report: counts of redacted tokens, top redaction rule hits, sample of 100 anonymized examples. post that we can sign off.

samir_r: cost estimate: reingest + redaction for 2M sampled events ~ 12 GPU-hours for classifier pass + storage. rough cost $1.2k. can we get capex from platform budget this quarter?

ben_ops: mark budget ask. if we chunk and throttle the job during off-peak, we can shave GPU needs. also consider using CPU-only fast regex pass first to drop trivial hits.

priya_k: rollout plan for product: 1) dry-run, 2) console toggles to show/hide backfilled data, 3) phased backfill by route (start with low-sensitivity routes), 4) full run.

alex_m: who owns this end-to-end? volunteers: samir (redaction pipeline), nina (validation + QA), ben (ops + cost), priya (console UX). i'll coordinate and circle back in triage tomorrow.

priya_k: timeline: dry-run this week, manual QA early next week, full backfill after sign-off by security. labeling request: can we get an SLO exception for metric drift during backfill window?

security: we can issue temporary exception but need final report and retention purge plan. also require retention cutoff: redact + delete originals after 90 days.

alex_m: noted. action items: create ticket (PLAT-4512) with steps above, owners, cost, and schedule. nina — please attach initial delta report to ticket after dry-run.

nina_g: will do. linking test query for sampling verification:

```
# verify sample provenance
SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry_staging
WHERE sample_rate = 0.02 AND redaction_stage = 'dry-run';
```

ben_ops: :thumbsup: good plan. tagging calendar invite for coordination. alex — can you add the triage meeting at 10am PST?

alex_m: scheduled. thanks everyone. :spiral_calendar:
